data.body: Execution preflight found that the remediated plan named parser factories, the CLI reference generator, generated route artifacts, and contract tests that were absent from the recorded file impact. Replaced the seven-path declaration with the complete 35-path planned edit set and expanded verification to cover both generators, focused unit contracts, public help parity, nested-family no-write behavior, formatter scope, lint, and type checking. This material correction intentionally invalidates the earlier attestation. A fresh plan review is required before claim.
